description: This file defines the main application class `NodeApp` for an Android app, which manages the lifecycle of a `NodeRuntime` instance and configures StrictMode for debugging.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: Android Application class that initializes runtime environment and configures debugging policies.

methods.name: ensureRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that a singleton instance of `NodeRuntime` exists; creates it if necessary.

methods.name: peekRuntime
methods.description: Returns the current `NodeRuntime` instance if it exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes application components and configures StrictMode policies if in debug mode.
